# A named slot inserted exactly once may be left unfilled, and its insertion's
# block renders instead. The block's nodes are the callee's, reached through
# the instance, and read as options: present where the call site filled
# nothing, absent where it filled the slot -- a node a splice dropped is null
# on every target, and the interpreter reads a child's refs off the tree its
# call site mounted.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component card(head component() node) node {
    vbox {
        head {
            text #dflt(value="Untitled")
        }
    }
}

component filled node {
    card #c {
        component head {
            text #title(value="Hi")
        }
    }
}

component empty node {
    card #c
}

func testFilled(t Test, x filled) {
    t.assert(x.c.title.value == "Hi")
    t.assert(x.c.dflt == null)
}

func testEmpty(t Test, x empty) {
    t.assert(x.c.dflt != null)
}
